role: Settings pages for custom reading tags and iCloud & Data (sync status/toggle, import/export links, strap RR recovery, storage summary, force sync, lost sessions, trash, settings backup/restore).
types: CustomTagsPage: struct (View) — list/add/delete custom ReadingTags in UserSettings
DataSettingsPage: struct (View) — iCloud sync and data recovery controls
state: mem:DataSettingsPage @State: showingRecoveryAlert, recoveryMessage, isRecovering, deletedSessionCount(-1 initial), isForceSyncing, showingForceSyncAlert, forceSyncMessage, isBackingUpSettings, isRestoringSettings, showingSettingsRestoreConfirm, showingSettingsBackupAlert, settingsBackupMessage
toplevel: Both pages read SettingsManager/LanguageManager (and DataSettingsPage RRCollector, ArchiveSignal, CloudKitSyncManager, AppDependencies) from the SwiftUI environment; languageManager is held only to re-render on language change.

units.does: Form with tagsSection, zen background, nav title "Custom Tags"; presents addTagSheet when showingAddTag.
units.entry: SwiftUI renders View.body when the view is pushed/updated (pushed from SettingsView.swift:253 and SettingsSearchIndex.swift:181)

units.does: Section listing settings.customTags rows with swipe-to-delete (onDelete → deleteTags) and the add button; footer explains tags.
HStack: tag colour dot + display name, combined accessibility label "Tag: name".

Resolves every swiped index to its tag first, then removes each via SettingsManager.removeCustomTag (each removal persists the settings file and posts settings-changed), so later indexes are not shifted by earlier removals.
units.entry: SwiftUI List .onDelete swipe action (via tagsSection closure)

units.does: AddTagSheet bound to newTagName/newTagColor with onSave → saveNewTag and existingTagNames = displayName of every tag (system + custom), so Save is refused for a name already shown.

Creates ReadingTag(name: newTagName trimmed of whitespace, colorHex: newTagColor.hexString), adds it via SettingsManager.addCustomTag, resets name and colour to blue. Duplicate names are refused by AddTagSheet before this runs.
Button that sets showingAddTag = true, labelled "Add Custom Tag".
Binding<UserSettings> get/set wrapping settingsManager.settings so Toggles can write settings (setter persists file + posts settings-changed).

Force iCloud sync: guarded against re-entry, records uploadedCount and lastSyncDate, awaits CloudKitSyncManager.performFullSync, then on main clears the spinner, builds the alert text with forceSyncOutcome and shows the alert.

branches.effect: returns immediately (double tap ignored); else proceeds

units.does: Alert text for a force sync: "iCloud unavailable" when the schema is unavailable this launch; the forceSyncSummary error text when syncState is .error; "Syncing…" when lastSyncDate did not change (the call was skipped because another full sync is running, so nothing synced); otherwise forceSyncSummary.
Builds the force-sync alert text from syncState and uploaded delta.

branches.effect: returns "Sync failed: msg. Try again in a moment."
returns "Synced N sessions to iCloud. Total uploaded: M."
returns "N sessions still pending retry. iCloud may be unreachable."; otherwise "Up to date. N sessions in iCloud." (also when the sync was skipped or still .syncing)

units.does: Form of status/import/storage/recovery/settings-backup sections; refreshDeletedCount on appear and on ArchiveSignal.version change; RR-recovery alert.
units.entry: SwiftUI renders View.body when the view is pushed/updated (pushed from SettingsView.swift:215, SettingsSearchIndex.swift:122)

units.does: Section with the iCloud Sync toggle bound to settings.iCloudSyncEnabled plus iCloudSyncDetail; footer on encryption/HealthKit scope.
Shows sync status and last-sync rows only when iCloud sync is on.
HStack "Status" + syncStateLabel.
Renders the CloudKit sync state.
Relative "Last Sync" row when a last sync date exists.
Section "Import & Export" with import link, export link, recover-from-strap button.
NavigationLink to ImportDataView (id data.import).
Label "Import RR Data".
NavigationLink to ExportDataView (id data.export).
Label "Export Data".
Button calling recoverRRData; disabled while recovering or when the Polar strap is not connected.
Label "Recover RR from Strap" with spinner or "Connect strap first" hint.

branches.effect: "Connect strap first" caption; else nothing trailing

units.does: Section "Storage Summary": archive count, uploaded count, pending row, unarchived backups row.
Row with collector.archive.entries.count.
Row with CloudKit uploaded count.
Row with pending iCloud retry count, only when > 0.
Row with unarchived raw-backup count, only when > 0.
Section "Recovery Actions": force sync button, Lost Sessions link, Trash link; hosts the force-sync result alert.
Button → forceCloudKitSync; disabled while syncing or when iCloud Sync setting is off (isCloudKitAvailable is only the setting).
Label "Force iCloud Sync" with spinner while syncing.
NavigationLink to LostSessionsView.
Label "Recover Lost Sessions" with unarchived-backup count badge.
NavigationLink to TrashView.
Label "Trash" with deletedSessionCount badge.
Footer text describing automatic encrypted settings backup on every change (except HealthKit-filled birthday/sex/weight).
Section "Settings Backup" with backup/restore buttons, restore confirmation dialog and result alert.
OK button (no-op) for the settings-backup alert.
Button → backupSettingsNow; disabled while backing up or when iCloud Sync is off.
Label "Back Up Settings to iCloud" with spinner.
Button that shows the restore confirmation; disabled while restoring or when iCloud Sync is off.
Label "Restore Settings from iCloud" with spinner.
Dialog buttons: destructive "Restore" → restoreSettingsFromCloud, and Cancel.
Dialog message: replaces current settings, archive unchanged.
Manual settings backup: re-entry guarded, awaits CloudKitSettingsSync.pushImmediately (returns false and sets status .error on skip/failure), then finishSettingsBackup on main.

branches.effect: returns (double tap ignored); else starts the push

units.does: Clears the spinner, builds the alert message from the push result and current CloudKitSettingsSync.status, shows the alert.
Static: alert text for a settings backup from (saved, status).

branches.effect: "Backup failed: msg. Check your iCloud connection…"
"Backup failed. Check your iCloud connection…"; saved continues
"Settings backed up to iCloud (date)" formatted medium/short in app locale

units.does: Manual restore: re-entry guarded; takes CloudKitSettingsSync from the view's own dependencies (as backup does), awaits restoreSettingsMessage(from:) (which performs the restore) and finishSettingsRestore on main.
Performs CloudKitSettingsSync.restoreFromCloud on the given instance and returns the alert text: "Settings restored from iCloud (last pushed <date>)" or "Restore failed: <reason>".
Clears restoring flag, puts the message into the shared settings-backup alert and shows it.
Counts trashed sessions via RRCollector.checkForDeletedSessions in a Task on the main actor (where RRCollector lives) and assigns deletedSessionCount.

Sets isRecovering, awaits RRCollector.recoverFromDevice (refuses unless strap connected/not live/not already saved; downloads the strap recording, writes a raw RR backup, assembles and analyses the session, sets collector.currentSession, and archives it for review only when its id is not already in the archive), then shows "RR points recovered: N" or the error via finishDeviceRecovery.
writes: archive:new session via MorningProcessing.archiveForReview (only when the session id is not already archived)

branches.effect: recoverFromDevice never returns nil (it returns the session or throws, RRCollector+Recovery.swift:58-69), so the 0 fallback applies only to a session without rrSeries

branches.cond: recoverFromDevice throws (notConnected, alreadyRecording, strapRecordingAlreadySaved, download error, or assembled session not .complete)
branches.effect: message "Recovery failed: <localizedDescription>"; error not logged here

units.does: Sets recoveryMessage, shows the recovery alert, clears isRecovering.
